title: The Same Chart, Twice the Pixels: Logical and Device Coordinates
fallback: This lesson is about the difference between the pixels you paint in and the pixels a screen has, so it needs a painter. Lesson 10-02 draws the same chart into a terminal, where there is exactly one kind of pixel and the question does not arise. Without Qt, do 10-02 and come back: what is here is the reason a chart that is correct on a laptop is drawn at quarter size on a better screen.

artifact.note: the two kinds of pixel kept apart, so a chart is the same chart on any screen
